---
title: "Totali per Persona"
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.7/css/dataTables.bootstrap5.min.css">
    include-after-body:
      - text: |
          <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js"></script>
          <script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.7/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js"></script>
          <script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.7/js/dataTables.bootstrap5.min.js"></script>
          <script src="totals.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<div class="container-fluid px-1 py-1">
<div class="row">
<div class="col-12">

<div id="loading" class="text-center py-5">
  <div class="spinner-border text-primary" role="status">
    <span class="visually-hidden">Caricamento...</span>
  </div>
  <p class="mt-3 text-muted">Caricamento...</p>
</div>

<div id="error-message" class="alert alert-danger border-0 rounded-3" style="display: none;"></div>

<div id="summary-container" style="display: none;">
  <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
    <div class="col-12 col-md-4">
      <div class="card border-0 bg-light rounded-3">
        <div class="card-body text-center py-3">
          <div class="small text-muted mb-1">Totale Generale</div>
          <h3 id="total-general" class="text-primary mb-0">€ 0</h3>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="col-6 col-md-4">
      <div class="card border-0 bg-light rounded-3">
        <div class="card-body text-center py-3">
          <div class="small text-muted mb-1">Persone</div>
          <h3 id="total-people" class="text-success mb-0">0</h3>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="col-6 col-md-4">
      <div class="card border-0 bg-light rounded-3">
        <div class="card-body text-center py-3">
          <div class="small text-muted mb-1">Media</div>
          <h3 id="average-person" class="text-info mb-0">€ 0</h3>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card border-0 rounded-3 mb-3">
    <div class="card-header bg-primary text-white border-0 py-3">
      <h5 class="mb-0"><i class="bi bi-calculator"></i> Dettaglio per Persona</h5>
    </div>
    <div class="card-body p-0">
      <div class="table-responsive">
        <table id="totalsTable" class="table table-striped table-hover mb-0">
          <thead class="table-light">
            <tr>
              <th class="small">Nome</th>
              <th class="small">Totale</th>
              <th class="small d-none d-md-table-cell">Transazioni</th>
              <th class="small d-none d-md-table-cell">Media</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

</div>
</div>
</div>

<style>
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  #totalsTable {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  #totalsTable th,
  #totalsTable td {
    padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem;
  }
  h3 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }
}
</style>
```
